name: messaging
title: Messaging
summary: Private service conversations linked to an order, item, return or case: customer with seller (or the Official Store), which Marketly support can join from a case, with attachments, read state, seller reply targets and overdue flags, and staff moderation. No promotional messages.
owns: Conversations between a customer and a seller (or the Official Store) about an order, item or return
Marketly support joining a customer-seller conversation from a case (participant and system note); the customer-Marketly case thread itself is the support case
Messages with attachments, system notes (e.g. support joined from a case) and read state per participant
Seller reply target (e.g. 24 hours), awaiting-reply and overdue flags, seller response statistics
Contact-detail and link masking, message reports and staff moderation (hide, lock)
notOwns: Customer-Marketly support conversations, formal case threads, evidence and decisions: support (support can join an order conversation and post into it)
Promotional messages: notifications; marketing consent: customers (promotions never appear here)
Email and push delivery of new-message notices: notifications (reads messaging.message.sent)

stateMachines.name: Conversation
stateMachines.notes: lock is a staff action with a reason (abuse, fraud), or trust's lock_conversation enforcement (only that action; restrict_customer_messaging is executed by customers and checked when the customer writes); the thread stays readable. Reversing the enforcement unlocks the conversations it locked (locked_by_enforcement_id). archive happens archiveAfterDays after the order completes; a new message about the same subject reopens it. A seller restriction never locks customer conversations about existing orders.

stateMachines.name: Seller reply
stateMachines.notes: Customer–seller and customer–Official Store conversations have a reply state (decision D-M1). reply_due_at = first unanswered customer message + sellerReplyTargetHours. Overdue seller conversations are highlighted in Seller Center and count in seller performance. For the Official Store, sellerReplies is a staff message, and while a conversation is awaiting_seller or overdue messaging keeps an official_store_reply work item open in workqueues (dedupe official_store_reply:<conversationId>, due at reply_due_at), resolved with resolveBySource when staff reply.

stateMachines.name: Message report
stateMachines.notes: Actioning hides the message or locks the conversation; serious cases are referred to trust.

CONVERSATION_LOCKED.meaning: The conversation is locked or archived for new messages. details.reason.

MESSAGING_RESTRICTED.meaning: The customer's account is restricted from messaging sellers (replies inside a case stay possible). details.reason, details.endsAt.

ORDER_NOT_ELIGIBLE.meaning: The caller cannot message about this order (not their order, or seller not in the order).

notes: Conversations are private to the customer, the seller and Marketly support. Sellers never see other sellers' conversations; staff reads are logged with a reason.
One conversation per customer + seller + subject (order, item or return); starting again appends to it, so history stays linked to the transaction.
Promotional messages are not allowed here; marketing goes through notifications with separate preferences (plan ch. 15, 19).
Product questions and answers are public and live in reviews; order-specific questions belong here.
clientMessageId makes sends safe to retry from the Android app without duplicates.

Guests can message about orders reached through guest order access (auth shopper). The key is the order, not the session (decision D-M2): a conversation on a guest order has customer_id null and a guest participant (id order:<orderId>) created with the conversation, so any later session with identity.hasGuestOrderAccess to the order sees it with its read state; guest_session_id only records the session that started it.

Official Store conversations (decision D-M1): customers reach the Official Store with with = official_store; seller_id is OFFICIAL_STORE_ID, the reply state and reply target apply as for sellers, staff answer from admin (sendStaffMessage, filter official_awaiting), messaging keeps an official_store_reply work item per waiting conversation, and messaging.message.sent with officialStore=true drives the staff notification topic for Official Store messages.
Personal data: exportForCustomer supplies the Messages section of the customer data export; customers.account.closed anonymises the customer's side of their conversations.

Conversation identity: case_id is a link, not part of the key, for order and staff conversations (a case can be opened on an existing conversation later); only support-kind conversations are keyed by case. Merging duplicates keeps the oldest conversation, moves messages and participants, recomputes reply_state, reply_due_at and unread counts from the merged messages, and records each removed id in conversation_aliases.
